summary: Netanyahu at UNGA declared Iran's regime will fall, claimed Israel destroyed Iranian military and nuclear facilities with US help, and staged a Starlink stunt for Iranian delegates. Houthi rebels launched six ballistic missiles at Saudi Arabia targeting Mecca, Taif, and Yanbu, all intercepted by Saudi air defenses with French military support deploying to protect Yanbu oil terminal. Iraq and the US signed an agreement to transfer the Victoria Base diplomatic support facility at Baghdad International Airport to Iraqi control, while Iran faces flight bans to UAE, Turkmenistan airspace restrictions, and currency collapse.
key_points: Netanyahu told UNGA Israel destroyed Iran's army, navy, air force, and nuclear facilities with US help, and predicted the regime's imminent fall. (Source: @kianmeli1/92455)
Netanyahu presented a Starlink kit at UNGA, offering it to the Iranian delegation so defectors could share their stories on social media. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7482)
Scores of delegates walked out during Netanyahu's speech; UAE was the only Arab delegation to remain. (Source: @presstv/208167, @presstv/208176)
Houthi rebels fired six ballistic missiles at Saudi Arabia targeting Mecca, Taif, and Yanbu; all were intercepted by Saudi air defenses. (Source: @VahidOnline/78509)
France announced deployment of troops, radar, and air defense systems to protect Saudi Arabia's Yanbu oil export terminal. (Source: @N12chat/227000)
Iraq and the US signed an agreement to hand over the Victoria Base diplomatic support site at Baghdad International Airport. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91502)
Iran's currency plummeted with the dollar reaching 235,400 tomans amid renewed sanctions and airspace restrictions by Turkmenistan. (Source: @VahidOnline/78511, @asafroz/53750)
IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas finance chief Muhammad Abu Alawan, who oversaw over 1 billion shekels in funding during the war. (Source: @almogboker78/18256)

points: Netanyahu claimed at UNGA that Israel, with US assistance, destroyed Iran's army, navy, air force, and nuclear facilities, calling the strike on nuclear sites "one of the easiest decisions" of his premiership. (Source: @mamlekate/104618, @kianmeli1/92455)

Iranian rial sharply depreciated Thursday, with the dollar rising 1.4% to 235,400 tomans, euro near 268,000 tomans, and gold coins surpassing 240 million tomans, following Pezeshkian's insistence on continuing nuclear program despite US pressure. (Source: @VahidOnline/78511)

All Iranian flights to the UAE were canceled, and a Tehran-Dushanbe flight was forced to return after Turkmenistan denied airspace access to Iranian carriers due to expanded US aviation sanctions. (Source: @shin_persian/10388, @asafroz/53750)
Chinese President Xi Jinping told Trump at the White House that China supports resuming US-Iran negotiations to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @asafroz/53761)

The US Senate rejected a bill that would have limited President Trump's war powers regarding Iran, signaling congressional reluctance to constrain executive military authority. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394625)
Iranian President Pezeshkian met Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam on the sidelines of UNGA, discussing bilateral relations amid regional tensions. (Source: @SharghDaily/185589)

Netanyahu offered a Starlink terminal to the UN Secretary-General to pass to the Iranian delegation, suggesting they could use it to defect and tell their stories freely. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7482)

Netanyahu addressed UNGA for 40 minutes, declaring Iran's "murderous and evil regime" will fall, accusing delegates of cowardice, and asserting Israel defends many nations whose leaders privately thank it for destroying Iranian nuclear capabilities. (Source: @mamlekate/104618, @Faytuks_Network/7472, @naya_foriraq/91507)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Hamas finance chief Muhammad Abu Alawan, who managed the group's budget for nearly a decade and directed over 1 billion shekels to fund military operations during the war. (Source: @almogboker78/18256)
Netanyahu brandished a Starlink device at the podium, stating he would leave it with the UN chief for the Iranian delegation to enable defectors' social media access. (Source: @N12chat/226995)
Israeli Hermes drones were reported flying low over Beirut amid attacks on southern Lebanon, according to Press TV. (Source: @presstv/208178)

Netanyahu referenced the pager attacks against Hezbollah, claiming terrorists are trying to reorganize and target Jews in historic Judea, including pregnant women and families, alleging media silence. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81424)
Delegates from numerous countries walked out during Netanyahu's speech, while the UAE remained the sole Arab delegation present. (Source: @presstv/208167, @presstv/208176)
Netanyahu reiterated that "the day is not far when the evil regime in Iran will fall and we will celebrate that day." (Source: @amitsegal/65178)

Israeli forces killed Hamas finance director Muhammad Abu Alawan, who oversaw transfer of over 1 billion shekels to Hamas military operations during the war and was involved in rebuilding the group's capabilities. (Source: @almogboker78/18256)

Netanyahu in his UNGA speech described Hamas's October 7 attack as the "largest massacre since the Holocaust," claiming they burned babies alive in front of parents and murdered civilians who had employed Gazan workers. (Source: @pkpoi/144070)
Netanyahu claimed at UNGA that Hamas murdered those who had employed Gazans from the border and returned them, and burned infants alive before their parents. (Source: @pkpoi/144070)

The Israeli Prime Minister asserted that Israel is defending countries whose delegates walked out, implying a connection between Gaza operations and broader regional security. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7472)
Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam met Iranian President Pezeshkian on the sidelines of the UNGA in New York. (Source: @SharghDaily/185589)
